name: Update for Sentinel Thenysil
summary: Word of relief travels from Stonetalon to Astranaar. After helping Kaela Shadowspear and Gaxim Rustfizzle against the Venture Company, you are sent to reassure Sentinel Tara Thenysil that their outpost still holds.

sections.title: A Dispatch from the Peaks
sections.body: Stonetalon's jagged passes leave the night elf frontier isolated and exposed. The Venture Company cuts down the crags and pollutes the waterways, threatening the outpost where Kaela Shadowspear and the gnome tinkerer Gaxim Rustfizzle serve. With the immediate danger blunted, Kaela sends you northeast across the border into Ashenvale to report that they remain safe.

sections.title: Relief in Astranaar
sections.body: In Astranaar, Sentinel Tara Thenysil watches Ashenvale's interior roads and worries over scouts sent into harsher lands. Word that Kaela and her engineering partner are alive and working to heal the land brings welcome relief. The report shows that, despite dwindling forces and threats on several fronts, cooperation with Alliance allies can slow the destruction.

faq.answer: Tara Thenysil is an officer of the night elf Sentinels stationed in Astranaar, the main Alliance hub in Ashenvale. She keeps watch on scouts and patrols sent into the surrounding wilds and nearby regions.

faq.q: Why is Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear was sent to Stonetalon to oppose the Venture Company's destructive exploitation of the land. She works with the gnome Gaxim Rustfizzle to sabotage goblin machinery and restore the land.

Gaxim Rustfizzle is an Alliance gnome engineer stationed with Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon. His noisy trade clashes with traditional elven ways, but his skill helps disrupt goblin logging machinery.

faq.q: Where do I find Sentinel Thenysil?
faq.answer: Sentinel Thenysil is in Astranaar, along Ashenvale's central road, northeast of the path down from the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What happens after reporting back to Sentinel Thenysil?
faq.answer: Reporting success in Stonetalon to Sentinel Thenysil opens further opportunities within the night elf military and leads to higher-level communications with Darnassus leadership.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company a threat in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Venture Company clear-cuts sacred groves, runs massive logging machinery, and poisons Stonetalon's waterways, threatening the natural balance guarded by the night elves.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can reassure the Sentinels that Kaela survived and their hold over Kalimdor's borderlands has not broken under industrial pressure.
As a gnome, you can take pride that even Sentinel Thenysil is relieved Gaxim Rustfizzle is safe. Gnomish ingenuity can earn respect among traditionalist elves.
As an Alliance member, you help keep communication open between Stonetalon's frontier posts and Ashenvale's strongholds, securing the Alliance presence in central Kalimdor.
